notes.title: Build 210605
notes.content:
Further performance improvements:
  - reduced number of pixel lights per object
  - slightly reduced shadow resolution
In some of the future updates, players will be able to choose between "Performance" mode with deferred rendering enabled that provides best performance and "Quality" mode that uses forward rendering, has no visual artifacts while offering less stable performance.

notes.title: Build 210601
notes.content:
* performance improvements:

    - enabled dynamic resolution
    - default frame rate set to 30 (when vSync is on) to make performance more stable

* minor scene tweaks to improve gameplay experience
